findings.note: RotoWire (Nov 15) says he played only 14 minutes against Cleveland and averaged just 0.9 threes per game over seven appearances in the prior two weeks, as his fast start faded.

His player page news says he is back in a bench role, his minutes have shrunk since early November, and his playing time depends on whether Flagg and Christie are available; it shows him at 1.0 threes per game on 25.8% from three this season.

In his latest logged game (Nov 15, a blowout loss to Boston) he scored 18 points in 26 minutes but went only 1-of-2 from three; his season-high four threes earlier came in extra minutes during a blowout loss to Minnesota.
